༄༅/ /dpal ldan mgon po legs ldan nag po'i dbang chog drag po sngags kyi rjes gnang dang bcas pa bde gsal don ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /dpe tshan 'di

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// dpal ldan mgon po legs ldan nag po'i dbang chog drag po sngags kyi rjes gnang dang bcas pa bde gsal don ldan zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

dpe tshan 'di sngon chad gter mdzod dkyus su med cing*/ bal yul zhe dgon gyi par gsar 'dir gsar bzhag byas pas dbang lung gi rgyun la zhib rtog dgos pa yin no// dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo chos kyi rje// sku lnga rab rdzogs drug pa rdo rje 'chang*// gnyis su med pa'i zhabs la gus btud nas// bka' sdod legs ldan nag po'i dbang chog bri// gzhung dang mthun pa'i gnas nyid du// tshad dang ldan pa'i bla ma dang*// snod dang ldan pa'i slob ma yis// dgos pa'i yo byad tshogs pa dang*/ khrag 'thung rnal 'byor ldan byas nas// thog mar sa lha'i rnal 'byor brtsam// las kyi lha bskyed mchog gtor brlab// oṃ bigh+nān+ta krita badz+ra a mṛta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ shūn+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ sur+yā/ tsaṇ+ḍa/ pad+ma/ dhū/ pu/ a/ gan/ nai/ sha /spro bsdu/ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke /gan+dhe/ nai bid+yā/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sarba pañca a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmāḥnaṃ a d+ya nut+pan+na twā ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ maṇ+ḍal bsang sbyang*/ lha mo gser mdog rgyan ldan bum 'dzin phag la bzhugs/ laṃ sarba saṃ/ laṃ ka la k+ṣa/ spro bsdu/ laṃ pra ti bh+ye swā hā/ dbang bskur byin rlabs spyan drangs bstim/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra swā bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ ma hā a dar+sha dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bhā wa ād+ma ko3 haṃ/ = oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gi /tshur gshegs sa yi lha mo che// mchod yon bzhes nas 'di nyid du// mchod pas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wān/ ma hā ka ru ṇī kā dri sh+ya hā+oḥ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ kun bzang phyi mchod phud gtor ni// bde bar gshegs pa lha mo che// de sogs tshig dang mdzod kyi sngags// rtsa sngags mchod sngags btags pas dbul// de nas bzlas dang bstod pa bya// laṃ pra ti bh+ye swā hā/

sa yi lha mo brtan ma gzi 'bar ma// sku gser phyag na gser gyi bum pa bsnams// 'ja' tshon mdog ldan phag gi khri la bzhugs// de la phyag 'tshal bsnyen bskur mchod cing bstod// skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par las// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// sa 'dir dkyil 'khor bri bar bya// rig pa 'dzin pas de ltar mdzod// gtor ma'i pha 'bab phyogs gnyis la// byin la grogs bcol bskrad par bya// lha mo dgyes nas sa la thim// lag pa rdo rje dang bcas pa// sa la gzug cing sngags 'di brjod// oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ༈ de nas lha yi sta gon ni// maṇ+ḍal bdud rtsis byugs par bya// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā maṇ+ḍa la sid+dhi ku ru hūm̐/ dur khrod skra y-is cha dbye zhing*// slob dpon bdag bskyed gsal btab la// maṇ+ḍal bh+rūm̐ las dur khrod khang*// bskyed cing khrag gi thig le las// so so'i gnas su rtsa sngags ni// gdan la lha rnams bskyed par bya// bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe badz+ra dz+nyā na tsakra bh+rūm̐/ sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ nṛ tri ti ra baṃ ti ra baṃ/ ko ka thang dmar rgya mtsho'i dbus// ma la ya yi ri rtse ru// pho brang lte ba gru gsum lnga// mu khyud khrag khyams sgo bzhir ldan// phyi rol 'obs mkhar brgyad dang bcas// rab tu 'jigs pa bskyed dbus su// dgra bgegs ro yi gdan steng du// oṃ ma hā kā la kro dha hūm̐/ rak+sha kro dhī shwa rī trag+mo he/ shar la sogs pa'i mkhar bzhi ru// kro dha dz+wa la/ yak+ṣa dz+wa la/ rak+sha dz+wa la/ tsit+ta dz+wa la sa ma ya/ khro bo gnod sbyin srin po dang*// ma mor bcas pa 'khor bcas bskyed// btson khang rnams la ma mo dang*// bar khyams dbang mo sgo bzhir sgo /gru bzhir gru 'degs bzhi dag rnams// 'obs mkhar rnams su 'bu chen dang*// mthar bya gcan zan la sogs pa// cho ga bzhin du bskyed byas la// bslab skur drangs bstims thim pa la// phyi nang mchod bzlas bstod pa ni// hūm̐/

lha yi ded dpon tshogs kyi bdag /legs ldan nag po mthu bo che// dur khrod bdag po sgrol ba'i ging*/ khro bo'i rgyal po khyod la bstod// hūm̐/ drag po sku lnga rgyal ba'i bka' sdod mchog /ye shes lnga ldan rgyal ba rigs lnga'i 'khor// phrin las bdud 'dul dgra bgegs kun gyi gshed// legs ldan 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod// de nas 'dod don gsol ba gdab pa ni// legs ldan 'khor bcas dgos su gsol/ khyed la mchod pa bya ba dang*// slob ma rjes su gzung bya'i phyir// bdag ni dkyil 'khor bgyid par 'tshal// sta gon la ni gnas par mdzod// de bzhin bgyi 'o de bzhin mdzod/ ༈ /de nas bum brtags bum pa gnyis// rgyan ldan bsang sbyang gong dang mtshungs// bh+rūm̐ bh+rūm̐/ spro bsdu/ bh+rūm̐ bi shwa= rnam rgyal bum pa'i gzhal yas su// 'khor bcas bskyed pa sgrub thabs bzhin// las bum gdan gsum chog gsum gyis// bdud rtsi 'khyil par bskyed pa ni// ljags gu rgya gram dril bu can// brlab cing dbang bskur mchod pa'i bar// gong bzhin byas la bzlas pa ni// mgon po'i bsnyen bsgrub bzhi sngags la// dbang sngags btags pa bzla bya zhing*// las bum gong la khrus sngags sbrel// mgon por gong bzhin bstod byas la// sems dpa' ljang gu sna tshogs phrin las bdag /sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs bsam mi khyab// ye shes bdud rtsis srid gsum 'od phung 'khyil/ khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil la phyag 'tshal bstod// mnyes zhu byin ldan chu ru bsam/ ༈ /de nas slob ma'i sta gon ni// slob ma khrus byas maṇ+ḍal phul// gral la rim par 'khod pa yis// gsol ba 'di skad gdab par bya// hoḥ rang bzhin 'du 'bral med pa'i lha// phyag rgya chen po'i tshogs mchog tu// bdag kyang mnyam par smra ba'i phyir// byi rlabs rab tu bzhugs su gsol// de 'dod slob bus sems gnyis bskyed// bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams// zhes pas kun rdzob sems bskyed cing*// e ma tshar lngas mchog sems bskyed// sems gnyis ldan la gsang don sbyin// e ma bde gshegs snying po las// rang gi rnam rtog las kyis sprul// sna tshogs lus dang longs spyod dang// gnas dang sdug bsngal la sogs pa// bdag dang bdag gir so sor 'dzin// sus kyang ma bcings bcing med de// bcing bar bya ba yod ma yin// rnam rtog bdag tu 'dzin pa yi// nan gyis mkha' la mdud pa 'dor// bcings med rnam par grol med pa'i// ye nas lhun rdzogs sangs rgyas chos/

khyod la rab tu bstan par bya// ces pa'i bar gyi don bshad do// de nas slob mas gsol gdab pa/ he ru ka dpal khyed la 'dud// thar lam chen po bdag 'dod de// de yi dbang dang dam tshig dang*// mgon po dpa' bor skyabs song zhing*// theg chen khang par 'jug pa dang*// mkhyen rab ye shes bdag la stsol// de nas rdo rje slob ma yi// tshe sba bgegs bskrad sgrib pa phral// lhar bskyed go bgo lus srung bya// ā yur+dz+nyā na bhin+dhu bh+rūm̐/ bi shwa badz+ra sngags kyi bskrad// lag sor brlabs phral bde stobs sbyangs// rtsa ba'i sngags kyis mgon por bskyed// go bgo lus bsrung bka' nan bcing*// de nas srung skud gsum sgril la// bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags kyis gdab// dpung par bcings pas lus dag bya// maṇ+ḍal rigs lnga'i rab gnas ldan// so shing dor ste ltas brtag go /oṃ badz+ra dzi ha saṃ bha ra dha ni hūm̐/ tsan+dan nam ni dri chu la// sngags btab khrus bshal khong du btung*// oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dha sarba dharma sarba pā paṃ ni tsa s+ya saṃ sho dha ni sarba bi kalpan a pa na ye swā hā/ dhi dang ha yis bsngags pa yi// ku sha sngon po gnyis byin la// sngas dang stan bya rmi lam brtag /'dri zhing ngan na bzlog par bya// de nas gegs brgyad bshad kyang rung/ ༈ /de nas thig mtshon byin brlabs te// legs ldan dkyil 'khor gzhung bzhin bri// las gzhung bsrang la bsgrub cing mchod// de nas dkyil 'khor 'jug pa ni// slob ma khrus byas maṇ+ḍal phul// de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dpal mgon legs ldan nag po yi// lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du// bdag cag 'jug par 'tshal lags kyis// dpa' bos thugs rjes gzung du gsol// lan gsum bla mas lan gdab pa// legs ldan nag po'i dkyil 'khor du// 'jug par 'dod pa'i bu khyod nyon// las dang bsam pa thams cad 'grub// bla med theg chen 'bras bu thob// gnas skabs bstan pa bsrung bya'i phyir// zhum med dkyil 'khor 'jug nus sam// slob mas nus zhes khas blangs la// bu khyod su yin ci la dga'// bdag ni las mchog skal bar ldan// bde mchog dga' tshal dkyil 'khor 'dir// sangs rgyas mdzad dka' spyad nas ni// 'gro ba thams cad bsgral bar mos// a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/

bi shwa badz+ra brjod/ ha la ha la raṃ/ kro ta kro ta yaṃ/ tik+ṇa tik+ṇa khaṃ/ ta keṃ ta keṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sdom pa rim par blang ba ni// rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal// zhes nas byang chub chen por bsngo// bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams// sogs dang e ma tshar lnga brjod// dam tshig khas su blang ba ni// kyai/ rdo rje chos dbyings kun gyi gtso// sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig ni// bde ba mchog gi dam pa ste// sems can don dang 'phrin las sgrub// sangs rgyas yon tan 'byung ba'i phyir// dam tshig dam pa bsrung bar bgyi// chos kun rang bzhin dag pas na// bdag kyang rang bzhin rnam par dag /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi// thugs dam dbyings mchog dkyil 'khor 'dir// sems can 'byams klas ma lus rnams// mchog nyid bsgrub par bgyis pas na// sku yi dbyig tu bdag skyed cig /slar yang ldog par mi bgyid do// bcom ldan thams cad mchog ni bdag lags te// mchog nyid bsgrub phyir rdo rje blang bar bgyi// rdo rje rgyal por khyod bzhugs pas// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje ste// rdo rje dam tshig mchog nyid ni// phun sum tshogs par bsgrub lags pas// bdag la dus 'dir bstsal du gsol// lan gsum bla mas bka' bsgo ba ni// 'di ni rgyal ba kun gyi thugs// sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig yin// lus ngag yid gsum sku gsung thugs// rtag tu 'bral bar ma byed cig /de ltar khyod kyis rtag tu spyod// tsan+dan chu dang bdud rtsi sbyin// 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// sangs rgyas kun khros khrag chen po// snying nas drangs te 'thung bar byed// oṃ yak+sha kro dha sa ma ya hūm̐/ de lta bas na bu khyod kyis// dam tshig 'di ni bsrung bar gyis// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// pañca a mṛta u tsit+ta a mṛta ṭha ṭha hūm̐/

de ring phan chad bu khyod kyi// phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyis// nga yis ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin/ khyod kyis de ltar bya dgos so// sa ma ya hūm̐/ hūm̐/ sngon tshe gong nas bsnyen pa'i lha// bdag gi nye gnas gang lags pa// las 'phro thugs rje ldan pa'i lha// gang yin de la 'bab gyur cig /pra tīts+tsha ho/ pra ti grih+ṇa swa mi maṃ satwa ma hā ba la/ rdo rje che ge mo zhes bya ba 'o// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang// dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /dpal he ru ka bdag la dbab tu gsol/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ ā+e h+ye hi bha ga wān ma hā ka ru ṇi ka dṛ sh+ya hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ pra be sha ya phaṭa/ a be sha ya a/ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ sngon gyi mig mkhan rgyal po yis// thur mas ling tog bsal pa ltar// bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i// rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal// oṃ badz+ra dz+nyā na tsak+ṣu pra be sha ya phaṭa/ oṃ muṃ hūm̐/ oṃ ni ye shes lhun gyis grub// muṃ ni ye nas rang sangs rgyas// hūm̐ ni rtsa ba byang chub sems// dkyil 'khor rnam gsum dbyer med pa// ha zhes mthong ba yongs su dag /ma 'dres yongs rdzogs mthong bar byed// pho brang dbus na thod mkhar lnga// dkyil na sgrol ging yab yum ste/ khro bo gnod sbyin srin po dang*// ma mo rim par phyogs bzhir gnas// btson khang srin mo bcu drug dang*// de mtha' thod pa'i phreng bas bskor// gru chad bzhi la gru 'degs bzhi// bar khyams khrag mtshor dbang mo dang*// sgo bzhir sgo ma chen mo bzhi// de dag mtha' na 'obs mkhar brgyad// kun gyi phyi na sha za dang*// gnod sbyin 'dre srin ro langs dang*// bya gcan lce spyang mang pos bskor// sha khrag rus pa ri dang mtsho// dur khrod gnas chen 'jigs par bstan/ ༈ /maṇ+ḍal phul la dbang nyid zhu// dbyings ni ye shes gtso mchog yin// rdo rje dam pa mchog 'dzin pa/

khyod ni dam tshig gtso lags kyis// dbang phyug rgyal por dbang skur cig /rin po che yi dbang 'di ni// sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag byas pa// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// dbang rdzas lnga dang slob ma la// rigs lnga'i rab gnas tshul bzhin bya// don lnga'i rtog pa so sor bskyed// mkha' dbyings rnam dag bum pa na// dpal ldan mgon po'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs// gnyis med byang chub sems rtags chus// byin rlabs mthu yi dbang thob shog /oṃ bhūr kur ma hā kā la kro dha hūm̐/ rak+sha kro dhī shwa rī trag mo he/ kro dha yak+ṣa rak+sha tsit+ta dz+wa la sa ma ya/ ha he phaṭa bh+yoḥ ru lu ru lu a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ badz+ra kā la sha /bud+dha kā la sha /rat+na kā la sha /pad+ma kā la sha /karma kā la sha a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ ye shes rin chen dbu rgyan mchog /gzi brjid phung po bla na med// sangs rgyas rin chen las byung ba'i// dbu rgyan mchog gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ chos kun rdo rje'i mtshan nyid de// rdo rje la yang mtshan nyid med// rdo rje lta bu'i rnal 'byor pas// chos kun rdo rje lta bur ltos// oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ 'di ni sangs rgyas gsungs dbyangs nyid// ye shes sems dpa'i dam tshig rnams// rdo rje sems dpa'i dka' thub dam// rtag tu khyod kyis bcang bar gyis// oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ yang dag bla med dkyil 'khor du// mtshan drangs rdo rje'i ming btags pa// sngags 'chang ming gi dbang bskur bas// rig 'dzin zhing du grags gyur cig /badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ ༈ gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba// maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// legs ldan nag po'i dkyil 'khor du// gsang ba mchog gi dbang bskur ba// de 'dir bdag la bstsal du gsol// dkyil 'khor rnam gsum dbyer med pa'i// yab yum gnyis med bde ba'i don// byang chub sems kyi thig le 'dis// bde chen rgyal por dbang bskur ro// a ho ma hā su kha bo dhi tsit+ta aḥ

gsum pa maṇ+ḍal phul la 'di skad zhu/ khyod ni dam tshig kun gyi gtso// rdo rje sems dpa' skyed mdzad ma// sems can don sgrub phrin las kyi// thugs rjes mnyam sbyor grub par mdzod// nye gnas kro dhī shwa rī ma// mtshan ldan sgeg cing mdzes pa mo// lhan cig skyes dga' skyed pa'i phyir// lha mo 'di dang rol par gyis// maṇ+ḍal phul nas 'di skad zhu// de bzhin gshegs pa dgyes pa bskyed// rdo rje chos dbyings kun gyi gtso// mi gnas chags pa chen po las// ma lus 'byung gnas bdag la stsol// gsang ba gsang chen rab gsang ba// rang gi sems kyi me long ltos// mthong bas de bzhin nyid du 'gyur// gzhan min rang byung de kho na 'o/ ༈ /de nas drag po'i rjes gnang ni// lcags khang dmigs rten byas pa'i mthar// drag po'i rdzas rnams dgram par bya// mgon po 'khor bcas bskyed bstim bskul// yon tan brjod la sbyin par bya// bsnyen sgrub rim pa'i sngags brjod cing*// man ngag thams cad rdzogs par sbyin/ ༈ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ral gri che// las kyi gri gug 'bar ba 'di// dgra bgegs gdug pa bsgral ba'i phyir// de ring khyod la sbyin par bya// badz+ra khaṅga a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ ti ra'i bing chen gsal shing 'di// srid gsum dbang du bsdu ba dang*// gdug pa rdul du brlag bya'i phyir// de ring khyod la sbyin par bya// ti ra dha ka dz+wa la a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ ye shes 'bar ba'i rdo rje 'di// dug lnga dbyings su bsgral ba dang*// sdig can lnga phung bshig pa'i phyir// de ring khyod la sbyin par bya// badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ drag po gnam lcags phur bu 'di// dbyings nas ye shes shar ba dang*// zhing bcu gnas su bsgral ba'i phyir// de ring= badz+ra kī la ya a bhi= thod rlon gdug pa'i khrag gis bkang*// 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa dang*// dam nyams snying khrag 'thung ba'i phyir// de ring=

ka pā la rak+ta a bhi= mdung rnon g.yang gzhi'i ru mtshon 'di// bdud kyi g.yul las rgyal ba dang*// rbad dbral snying gzer gdab pa'i phyir// de ring= badz+ra shū la a bhi= dug sbrul 'bar ba'i zhags pa 'di// 'khor ba'i gnas nas drang ba dang*// bla srog yar ba bsdam pa'i phyir// de ring= nā ga pā sha a bhi= chos sku yon tan mchog mnga' ba'i// phyag mtshan drag po tsa ma ra// dam can gnas nas 'bod pa'i phyir// de ring= badz+ra tsa ma ra a bhi= legs ldan khro rgyal thugs ka nas// tsar sha pa ni mtshon cha mchog /yungs dkar rgyal po sha rī ram// de ring= badz+ra pe ta li rak+sha a bhi= gu gul sbyar ba'i rdzas mchog 'dis// dgra bo lha dang dbye ba dang*// bgegs rnams myos dang bskrad pa'i phyir// de ring= ma gu ta la pra ta la a bhi= ri rab gling bzhi rgya gram 'dis// rtog pa'i zug rngu gzhil ba dang*// gdug pa can rnams mnan pa'i phyir// de ring= bhi shwa badz+ra suṃ e baṃ mā yā a bhi= ye shes 'bar ba'i me phung 'dis// nyon mongs 'khor ba'i bag chags dang*// dgra bgegs thams cad bsreg pa'i phyir// de ring= badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ a bhi= thabs shes chags sdang mda' gzhu dang*// drag po'i thun dang rdzas 'di yis// dgra bgegs rdul du brlag bya'i phyir// de ring khyod la sbyin par bya// badz+ra t+g+ṇī khat+ga a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ de nas zhabs la spyi bos gtug /yon mchog dbul zhing gtang rag gtang*// tshogs kyi mchod pas mnyes par bya// lhag brtan gshegs bsdu lus srung bsngo// dza gad rdzas kyi bkra shis gsol// dpal ldan mgon po legs ldan nag po'i dbang dang drag po sngags kyi rjes gnang bla ma gong ma'i yi ge phyag bzhes cung zad nyog se bar mngon nas/ dur khrod mngon par rol pa mtshon cha 'khor lo dang*/ dug gi spu gri'i rgyud dang*/ rgya gzhung dang yang mthun phyir gsal bar gtsang shod sa ma tī dh+wa dzas bsdebs pa/
bde gsal don dang ldan pa zhes bya ba 'dis 'gro ba mang po'i don byed par gyur cig /nongs pa ci mchis bzod par mdzad du gsol// bkra shis par gyur cig /

brgyud pa ni/ chos sku kun bzang*/ longs sku rigs lnga/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/ rgyal po dzaḥ ku ku rā dza/ ro langs bde ba/ rdo rje bzhad pa/ dharma bo dhi/ ba su dhā ra/ gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes/ gnubs yon tan rgya mtsho/ myang chen sher mchog /nyang ye shes 'byung gnas/ zur po che shākya 'byung gnas/ zur chung shes rab grags pa/ glan ston shākya bzang po/ 'dar nag pa bsod nams grags pa/ 'dar nag kun dga'/ jo btsun shes rab 'bar/ hor nag dbang sgron/ mkhas btsun chos skyong 'od/ 'dar nag shākya byang chub/ 'dar nag kun dga' 'od/ bar ston blo gros rgyal mtshan/ snar ston shākya shrī/ snar ston bud+dha dh+wa dza/ shākya ram pa/ rdo rje chos rgyal bzang po/ spang ston chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ de gnyis ka las zur tsho stod pa slob dpon chen po bde legs rgyal mtshan/ des se ston rin chen rgyal mtshan/ des gnubs ston rat+na shrī bha dra/ des dpal he ru ka'i ngo bo zur dbang rgya hor rdo rje/ des gtsang bsang ston gyi sa'i thig le gsal ba gong gi 'du khang gi steng du/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa slob dpon pad+ma dbang rgyal rdo rje/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhyen rab dbang phyug dbon po rnams la sgyu 'phrul zhi khro dong sprugs legs ldan dang bcas pa'i dbang rdzogs par dgyes bzhin bka' bstsal pa/ bstan pa dar rgyas 'gro ba smin grol shog /lha btsun gter bton gyi dpe 'o// ༈ //'di ni gtsang shod pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi chog khrigs su grags pa ste yig cha 'di dbang gi rtsa tho dang rtsa tshig tsam las mi 'dug cing*/ rdor brag rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma phrin las kyi gsung mdo dbang chen mo dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs kyi mtha' rten bka' srung gi dbang dang rjes gnang gi skabs/ tshul 'di mtshams sbyor gyis legs par spros par snang bas de'i dbang lung gi rgyun yang ma chad par bzhugs shing*/
